title: Chat & AI
description: Your defaults for chat and the Writing Studio, in one place. Each row shows its effective value and source; sessions and Studio tools inherit these defaults and may override them.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.description: These settings were previously applied silently. They are now visible and editable; blank means the system default.

permission.label: Tool authority
permission.hint: How much the assistant may do without asking. The default is Write.

grounding.title: Grounding & memory
grounding.label: Ground answers in my story
grounding.description: Include canonical entities, facts, and manuscript passages in each answer. This is enabled by default and can be switched off.
grounding.offWarning: Grounding is off — the assistant cannot access your story bible and may invent lore. Turn it on for accurate answers.

context.title: Context management
context.description: How the assistant manages the memory budget for very long conversations. Most people should leave this on Auto.
context.label: Long-work context mode
context.hint: Auto enables long-work tiers only when a project needs them. Off keeps the simplest path.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Speech input and output for chat. These settings are saved to your account and applied to voice messages.
voice.hint: A voice is specific to its model — choose one supported by your TTS model.

session.label: this chat
session.title: Set on this chat — overrides your account and book defaults.

unavailable.label: unavailable
unavailable.title: The owning tier could not be reached.
